items.installed_note: a streetlight IS in frame casting long shadows on the pavement - the beat says lit only by whatever streetlight reaches them and this is that literally. Both bodies visible, he behind her, she braced on the wall. Reads candid, not produced
face-down FLAT on a kitchen table, arms forward, him behind, and it stays that way in all 4 frames. Upper body down is the part most candidates fail and this one holds it
eyes locked at camera in ALL 4 frames, never breaks; brightest + most legible of the pool

the ONLY candidate in the pool with a hand at the back of her head across all 4 frames - placed, not gripping, no hair pulled taut. She is calm and not mugging. Beat match on the one gate that mattered
full arc in one loop: frame1 still inside, frames2-4 cum running out in a thick unbroken line. The most legible proof in the pool - and proof IS the heat carrier for this beat

the ONLY clip in the pool containing the clothed state AND the reveal in one loop: frame1 dressed, frame2 mid-lift blur, frames3-4 out with the top held up ready to drop. Eye contact held throughout. Slug literally said quick-flash
THREE men in frame simultaneously in every one of the 4 frames, one woman kneeling in the middle - a literal ring around her head. The count gate is unambiguous, which is the whole point of this slot
he is flat on his back, VISIBLE and doing nothing in all 4 frames while she sets the pace. Non-POV, well lit, his slackness is legible - which is the entire meaning of this beat
curtainless window, bare floor, peeling walls, debris, daylight, NO people. Highest resolution in the pool (large_2x) which matters here because a location image renders large and static
the only TRUE downblouse in the pool - she is bent over a task and the view down the top is incidental, then she catches the lens and grins. Clothed all 4 frames. Withholding + awareness both present
